plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Une règle déclenche des actions Jeedom q: A rule triggers Jeedom actions when several detections happen within a short interval: motion alone is often a false positive, motion together with a crossed line almost never is.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Remplit les conditions et les délais. To: Fills in the conditions and delays. Everything stays editable afterwards.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.« Fois » exige plusieurs occurrences de: “Times” requires several occurrences of the same detection: three passes in front of the same camera, for instance.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Secondes. Écart maximal entre la premièr: Seconds. Maximum gap between the first and the last detection. The whole chain works to the second: a 15 s window is in practice 14 to 16 s.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Sur au moins deux caméras différentes: On at least two different cameras
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.« La même caméra » est la double détecti: “The same camera” is local double detection; “two different cameras” is corroboration, where repetition on a single channel is not enough.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Secondes. Délai minimal avant un nouveau: Seconds. Minimum delay before triggering again. Without it, a single pass triggers five times.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Secondes pendant lesquelles la commande: Seconds during which the “Triggered” command stays at 1.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Facultatif. La règle ne déclenche que si: Optional. The rule only triggers if this expression is true.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.La commande « Déclenchée » change d'état: The “Triggered” command changes state in any case: these actions are only useful if you want to avoid writing a scenario.
Played at the end of the hold time.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Joue le déclenchement pour de vrai, acti: Plays the trigger for real, actions included. The cooldown and the arming condition apply.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Décocher « Activer » en haut de cette pa: Unchecking “Enable” at the top of this page disarms the rule entirely, and a scenario can do it too.
Played at the end of the hold time. On a quiet installation the release can take up to a minute longer: it is checked on every incoming detection, and otherwise once a minute.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.« Tester » joue le déclenchement pour de: “Test” plays the trigger for real, actions included, and starts the cooldown. “Reset” returns the rule to idle, plays the release actions and forgets pending detections.

plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Le tableau ci-dessus dit d'où chaque dét: The table above says where each detection is allowed to come from. This field says whether they must also come from the same place, or on the contrary from different ones.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Exemple : « Ligne franchie » + « Mouveme: Example: “Line crossed” + “Motion”, any camera, “from one and the same camera” — the rule triggers as soon as any single camera sees both. That is double detection.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Une caméra qui décroche ne produit aucun: A camera that drops out produces no event: the NVR announces nothing. The daemon therefore checks their state regularly, and these actions are run ONLY ONCE at the moment a camera is lost — not on every check. Available tags: #camera#, #channel#, #nvr#, #state#.
plugins/dahua/desktop/php/dahua.php.Jouées quand une caméra précédemment sig: Run when a camera previously reported lost becomes reachable again. A disconnection of the NVR itself triggers neither these actions nor the previous ones: you are warned once, by the NVR.

plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Port sur 127.0.0.1 par lequel Jeedom tra: Port on 127.0.0.1 used by Jeedom to send orders to the daemon. Change it only on conflict.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Attente avant de retenter une connexion: Delay before retrying a lost NVR connection.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Certains événements n'ont pas de fin ann: Some events have no end reported by the NVR. The command falls back to 0 after this delay.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Une capture au maximum toutes les 10 sec: At most one capture every 10 seconds per camera. The image is exposed by the "Last snapshot" command.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Les plus anciennes sont supprimées autom: The oldest ones are deleted automatically.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Une caméra qui décroche ne prévient pas: A camera that drops out gives no warning: the NVR emits no event. The daemon therefore polls its state at a regular interval. 0 disables monitoring; minimum 15 seconds.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Capturer une image fraîche à chaque aler: Take a fresh snapshot on every alert
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..En plus de l'image du moment de la détec: In addition to the image at detection, ask the NVR for a snapshot of the cameras involved at alert time. Uncheck it if the NVR is fragile or the link slow.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Nombre total de dossiers d'alerte gardés: Total number of alert folders kept, all rules taken together: a chatty rule therefore evicts the history of the others, except the latest alert of each, always kept. From 1 to 5000, 300 by default; an empty or out of range value falls back to the default. Count about 50 MB per camera involved for 300 alerts.
plugins/dahua/plugin_info/configuration..Au-delà de ce rang, seules les vignettes: Beyond this rank only the thumbnails and the description are kept: the alert stays readable but loses the enlargement. A full resolution image weighs 600 KB to 1 MB, and an alert carries up to two of them per camera. The latest alert of each rule, the one its tile shows, always keeps its full resolution. 0 to keep thumbnails only, including that one; the value is lowered to the previous setting if it exceeds it.
